title: REST deficiency and neurogenic-to-gliogenic shift in down syndrome human cerebral organoids.
authors: Huang, Tan; Lim, Chong-Teik; Li, Wei; Fakurazi, Sharida; Mason, John O; Cheah, Pike-See; Li, Yi; Ling, King-Hwa
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用转录组分析和机器学习研究唐氏综合征脑类器官中REST缺陷导致的神经发生向胶质发生转变，虽涉及基因调控网络但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Down syndrome (DS) features impaired cortical neurogenesis and excess gliogenesis, yet the temporal regulatory events driving this imbalance remain unclear. Here, we combine multi-timepoint transcriptomic analyses from publicly available datasets, network modelling, and machine-learning prioritization, with validation in isogenic human iPSC-derived cerebral organoids, to identify a discrete pathogenic window at 90 days in vitro (DIV 90). Across five developmental stages, REST target genes were preferentially dysregulated in DS organoids. WGCNA revealed a DS-associated module at DIV-90 that strongly overlapped with REST targets, and two orthogonal machine-learning approaches converged on six REST-regulated hub genes-CSTB, MCM3AP, PFKL, POFUT2, PRMT2, and RWDD2B. In trisomic organoids, REST mRNA and nuclear protein were markedly reduced at DIV-90, accompanied by diminished DCX expression and activation of NFIA and STAT3, suggesting a neurogenic-to-gliogenic fate transition. These findings suggest REST dysfunction as a potential temporal regulator of lineage imbalance in DS and highlight REST-linked networks as potential targets for early developmental intervention.
abstract_zh: 唐氏综合征（Down syndrome, DS）以皮层神经发生受损和胶质发生过度为特征，但驱动这种失衡的时序调控事件仍不清楚。在此，我们结合来自公开数据集的多时间点转录组分析、网络建模和机器学习优先级排序，并在同基因人类iPSC来源的脑类器官中进行验证，以识别体外第90天（DIV 90）的一个特定致病窗口。在五个发育阶段中，REST靶基因在DS类器官中优先失调。WGCNA揭示了一个在DIV-90时与DS相关的模块，该模块与REST靶标高度重叠，两种正交机器学习方法收敛于六个REST调控的枢纽基因——CSTB、MCM3AP、PFKL、POFUT2、PRMT2和RWDD2B。在三体类器官中，REST mRNA和核蛋白在DIV-90时显著减少，伴随DCX表达降低以及NFIA和STAT3的激活，提示神经发生向胶质发生的命运转变。这些发现表明REST功能障碍可能是DS中谱系失衡的潜在时序调控因子，并强调REST相关网络作为早期发育干预的潜在靶点。
